description: Fix E2E walkthrough failures: tasks passes reset, pipeline error visibility, CLI logs pipeline events, ACP spawn absolute path

tasks.title: Reset all task passes to false at runRalphLoop entry
tasks.description: In `ralph-executor.ts` `runRalphLoop()`, after `readTasks()` and `sortTasksByOrder()`, add a loop that sets `task.passes = false` for every task. Then call `writeTasksFile(change.tasksPath, tasks)` to persist the reset. This must happen before the `while (true)` task execution loop.
acceptanceCriteria: runRalphLoop resets all tasks' passes to false before execution
Reset is persisted to tasks.json via writeTasksFile
findNextPendingTask finds tasks that were previously passes=true
Existing tests pass
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: See design.md D1. This is the critical fix — without it, build stage skips all tasks.

tasks.title: Persist pipeline failure message in approvalState
tasks.description: In `agent-runner-service.ts` `executePipeline()`, in both the result-failure branch (line ~280) and the catch branch (line ~322), before setting status to blocked, write the error message to `approvalState` with `status: 'error'` and `output: { error: message }`. Use `issueRepo.setApprovalState(issue.id, { stage: currentStage, status: 'error', output: { error: errorMsg }, requestedAt: new Date().toISOString() })`.
acceptanceCriteria: Blocked issues have approvalState.status = 'error' with the failure message
Both result-failure and exception paths write the error
API /issues/:number returns the error in approvalState.output.error
Existing tests pass
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: See design.md D2. Reuse approvalState to avoid schema migration.

tasks.title: Show error state in mo issue show
tasks.description: In `cli/commands/issue.ts` show action, after the Stage/Status output, check if `approvalState.status === 'error'`. If so, print an `Error:` line with `approvalState.output.error`. Also show approval state for awaiting/approved/rejected status.
acceptanceCriteria: mo issue show displays error message for blocked issues with approvalState.status=error
mo issue show displays approval state for awaiting/approved/rejected
No extra output when approvalState is empty
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: The API already returns approvalState in the issue response.

tasks.title: Add pipeline events to mo issue logs command
tasks.description: In `cli/commands/issue.ts` logs action, before trying to read log files, call the API `GET /issues/:number/logs` with eventType filter for pipeline events (build_started, build_completed, build_failed, task_started, task_completed, task_failed). Display them in a human-readable format with timestamps. If no pipeline events exist, fall back to the existing file-based log reading.
acceptanceCriteria: mo issue logs shows pipeline events (build/task start/complete/fail) from workflow_log
Each event shows timestamp, type, and summary
Falls back to file-based logs when no pipeline events exist
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: The API endpoint GET /issues/:number/logs already exists and supports eventType filter.

tasks.title: Use resolveOpencodeBinPath in ACP session spawn
tasks.description: In `acp-session.ts`, in both `runAcpSession` and `runMultiRoundAcpSession`, when `opencodeBinPath` is not provided (falsy), call `resolveOpencodeBinPath()` from `config/config-loader` to get the absolute path. Use that path instead of the bare `'opencode'` string fallback.
acceptanceCriteria: ACP session spawn uses absolute path when opencodeBinPath not provided
spawn no longer depends on PATH containing opencode
Explicit opencodeBinPath still works unchanged
Existing tests pass
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: See design.md D4. resolveOpencodeBinPath() is already exported from config-loader.
